admission.justification: A selection during recovery could otherwise cause another load and prevent readiness from arriving.

applicability: Selection changes during the readiness wait started by a document load.
conditions: Only the latest requested selection is retained.
Ready or pong restores a supported message channel.
exclusions: An explicitly unsupported-open plugin remains URL-only.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoFrameLateAnswer.test.tsx › "holds a change made right after that load for the loaded document's ready report, and loads again only on another unanswered ping"; red on the bytes of Attempt2: notes/reports/worker/c41a5d77-92e0-4b18-a3d6-140c0a7e0b50/after-evidence-attempt3/red/dashboard-red.txt

statement: A change of the selection made while a load's ready report is still awaited is held: it goes out by message at the report, and it loads only when the ping after that load stays unanswered too.
